full_name: Jennifer E. Hoffman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Physical Sciences Radcliffe Alumnae Fellow Harvard University
bio: Jennifer E. Hoffman is an associate professor of physics in the Faculty of Arts and Sciences at Harvard University. She uses innovative microscopy techniques to image and influence the behavior of electrons in exotic materials such as high-temperature superconductors and topological insulators.
